hypothesis: A host with an invalid punycode label is refused 400 INVALID_HOST by handleRequest's RISK-013 gate (proxy.go:1702-1708, normalizeHostStrict fails) but apiPolicyTest explicitly does not refuse on normalization failure (ui_policy.go:2840-2854) and PolicyStore.Evaluate uses the fail-open normalizeHost (policy.go:1802, hostutil.go:27-32), so tester/eval/reload match a rule the proxy never evaluates.

The request log entry has no groups field (internal/logstore/logstore.go:63-105; AuthLogFields.applyTo store.go:367-376 writes only identity/auth_source), so a Policy Tester call built from the log carries no groups and a sourceGroup rule that enforcement matched (proxy.go:483,1738 -> containsGroupCI policy.go:2356) is skipped as source mismatch in apiPolicyTest (ui_policy.go:2896).

canonicalDestLiteral only canonicalizes hosts containing ':' and netip accepts one IPv4 text form (policy_destliteral.go:27-44), so non-dotted-quad IPv4 spellings (decimal/hex/short) of the address a destFQDN rule names are compared as plain hostnames and miss the rule on every path.

net/http percent-decodes non-ASCII escapes in the request-target host, so handleRequest sees r.Host as the UTF-8 IDN (proxy.go:1616,1681) and matches the IDN rule, while the tester (ui_policy.go:2880) and a direct Evaluate receive the literal %-escaped authority, which normalizeHost leaves as plain ASCII (hostutil.go:95 fast path) and matches nothing.

A link-local client arrives as a zoned address (clientIP 'fe80::1%eth0' from net.SplitHostPort, proxy.go:1555); clientSource.parseAddr rejects zoned addresses (policy.go:2318-2323) and the tester's fallback matchIPOrCIDR uses net.ParseIP which also rejects them (policy.go:2416), so a sourceIP CIDR rule matches the unzoned spelling of the client but not the zoned one.

A host whose canonical form exceeds 253 bytes is refused 400 by handleRequest (proxy.go:1616-1620, proxy_host_bounds.go:399) and by apiPolicyTest (ui_policy.go:2842-2847), but PolicyStore.Evaluate has no length gate (policy.go:1781-1805) so eval/reload still match a catch-all rule.

net.SplitHostPort accepts a non-numeric port, so bareDestHost in the tester (proxy_host_bounds.go:206-211, ui_policy.go:2880) and the eval path strip ':http' and decide on example.com, while the listener's net/http request-target parsing rejects the non-numeric port with 400 before handleRequest runs.

A raw UTF-8 IDN authority is rejected by net/http (malformed Host header, non-ASCII bytes) before handleRequest, while apiPolicyTest and Evaluate IDNA-normalize it (normalizeHost, policy.go:1802 / ui_policy.go:2787) and match the punycode rule.

normalizeHost uses the bare idna.ToASCII Punycode profile with no UTS-46 mapping (internal/hostutil/hostutil.go:126-135), so a compatibility spelling a browser maps to example.com (fullwidth 'e', sent percent-encoded) is punycoded into a different name and misses the example.com rule on every path.

An unbracketed IPv6 authority is rejected by the Go >=1.26 URL parser (colon in host) before handleRequest, while bareDestHost/SplitHostPort fail softly and canonicalDestLiteral (policy_destliteral.go:31-44) lets the tester and Evaluate match the IPv6 rule.

The Basic-credential arm takes identity from Identity.Sub only and treats an empty Sub as unresolved (proxy.go:479-482, 499-506 -> 407), unlike the session arm which falls back to Email (proxy.go:449-452); an IdP identity with only an email is refused by http/connect while a direct evaluation with that identity matches the sourceIdentity rule.
